UPDATE llm_providers
            SET name = $2, kind = $3, base_url = $4, model = $5, timeout_ms = $6,
                max_retries = $7, input_cents_per_mtok = $8, output_cents_per_mtok = $9,
                api_key_nonce = $10, api_key_ciphertext = $11, enabled = $12, updated_at = $13
            WHERE id = $1
